timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi everybody, I'm Brad Pockett and I'm looking to represent you here in the 78th district.
I'm originally from the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, a Uper, but I've been down here because I've
been investing in the lives of young people and their families. I've been getting geared up and
prepared to become a politician because I have been learning about families and now I'm ready
to bring my platform to a higher level where I can be a bold leader for the 78th district.
So many policies are made that affect people that they don't even know who they're affecting when
they sign off on a policy. That is exactly what has caused me to run for state representative.
Because any kind of bill or legislation that comes my way, I'm going to make sure that I'm in touch
with someone that it represents or affects. I believe that being in touch with people that I
represent in Lansing is the key to making bold decisions. So I'm reaching out to you to connect
with me to talk about what matters most here in the 78th district of Michigan.
